meta.title: Fogar TV — You talk. The TV handles it.
meta.description: Fogar TV turns the TV you already own into Fogar's screen: it answers without covering what you watch, your phone is the remote, and it's an open ecosystem you can plug your own things into.

s1.headline: You talk. The TV handles it.
s1.subhead: The TV you already own, turned into Fogar's screen.
s1.caption: Your TV, when nobody's using it.

s2.caption1: You're watching something. Fogar answers up top, without pausing anything.
s2.caption2: And what it has pending stays in sight.

s3.caption1: When there's screen to spare, you see everything it does.
s3.caption2: It opens websites, plays music, launches whatever you ask.

s4.caption1: Nothing to install: it's a web page on your phone.
s4.caption2: Trackpad, keyboard, volume and Fogar's voice.

s5.caption1: A code on the TV and you're in.
s5.caption2: You, your family and your guests, each with their own place.

s6.line1: A mini PC or that old laptop you no longer use, an HDMI cable and your phone.
s6.line2: Fogar TV provides the screen; fogar-gateway connects it to Fogar's brain.
s6.soon: For now you install it by hand, following the <readme>READMEs</readme>.
s6.network: It's an open ecosystem: anyone can build compatible pieces and plug in their own. Away from home, through the tunnel or proxy you choose.
s6.alt: Diagram: a mini PC or old laptop connects over HDMI to the TV; fogar-gateway connects it to Fogar's brain and to your phone.

items.title: Stage
items.body: Fogar puts presentations, tasks and alerts on top of any website.

items.body: The model and voice you prefer, without being tied to any.
